mission: It is Mom's birthday tonight! Dad hid her gift somewhere in the house and left a trail of sticky notes so you can bring it out at dinner. Find EXACTLY where the gift is hidden, and prove it.
answer: Inside the piano bench in the living room

p01.title: Hallway (front door)
p01.content: Dad's sticky note on the front door: 'Mom's gift is hidden in the house. Follow my notes! Note 1 is stuck on the coldest thing in the house.' The hallway leads to the kitchen, the living room, the staircase and the garage.

p02.title: Kitchen
p02.content: Dad's Note 1 is on the fridge door: 'Well done! Note 2 is where Mom's favourite songs are played.' Next to it is a note in your little brother Rohan's handwriting: 'The gift is in the GARAGE!!! hehe just kidding.' The kitchen opens to the pantry, the back garden and the living room.

p03.title: Pantry
p03.content: A large box wrapped in shiny gold paper sits on the top shelf. Its label says: 'Diwali sweets - for the neighbours.' Not a birthday gift. Nothing else here.

p04.title: Back garden
p04.content: There is a patch of freshly dug soil near the roses. Looking closer, it is just where Bruno the dog buried his bone. No notes here.

p05.title: Living room
p05.content: The living room has a sofa, the TV, a music system on a shelf, and Mom's old piano. Mom plays the piano every Sunday evening - her favourite songs are the old film songs she plays on it. The music system is mostly used by Dad to listen to cricket commentary.

p06.title: Music system shelf
p06.content: Tucked behind the speaker is an old, faded sticky note in Dad's handwriting: 'Last clue: look in the attic!' The note is dated LAST YEAR - it is left over from last year's birthday hunt.

p07.title: Piano
p07.content: Dad's Note 2 is on the piano's music stand: 'You found Mom's favourite spot! The gift is NOT inside the piano. It is hidden in the thing she sits on when she plays. Look for blue wrapping paper.'

p08.title: Sofa
p08.content: Under a sofa cushion is a small gift wrapped in RED paper. The tag says: 'For Rohan's friend Arjun - birthday party on Saturday.' This is not Mom's gift.

p09.title: Staircase
p09.content: The staircase goes up to the kids' bedroom, Mom and Dad's bedroom, and the attic.

p10.title: Kids' bedroom
p10.content: Your sister Meera has left a note on her desk: 'I KNOW where Mom's gift is - it's in Mom's wardrobe!!' Meera is five and did not help Dad hide anything.

p11.title: Mom and Dad's bedroom
p11.content: A neat, tidy room. Mom cleans this room every single day, so Dad would never hide her gift here - she would find it at once. There is a wardrobe in the corner.

p12.title: Attic
p12.content: Dusty and dark. There is a crumpled piece of torn wrapping paper with 'Happy Birthday' on it - from LAST year's gift. Nothing new has been put here this year.

p13.title: Garage
p13.content: Two bicycles, Dad's toolbox and the car. No sticky notes and no gift. Rohan's 'just kidding' note was a prank.

p14.title: Piano bench (opened)
p14.content: You lift the lid of the piano bench. Under Mom's sheet music is a box wrapped in BLUE paper. The tag, in Dad's handwriting, says: 'Happy Birthday, my dear! Love, the whole family.' This is Mom's gift!

p15.title: Wardrobe
p15.content: Only Mom's saris and an old shoebox full of family photographs. No gift here - Meera was wrong.
